name: Black bag limit exemption
description: Application to Swansea Council for permission to place out additional black bags of non-recyclable household waste where all accepted kerbside materials are recycled and excess waste arises from specified waste types.
applicant_type: Household residents in Swansea Council area who recycle all accepted kerbside materials but still produce more than 3 black bags of non-recyclable waste, specifically due to nappies, pet litter, or pet bedding
caseworker_type: Swansea Council waste services / household waste exemption processing team

application_tracks.fee_detail: No fee mentioned in the scraped content
additional_requirements: Applicant must recycle all accepted kerbside materials
Applicant must produce more than 3 black bags of non-recyclable waste
There must be no recyclable material in any black bags or exemption bags
Exemption is available for waste such as pet litter or bedding and disposable nappies

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Applicant produces more than 3 black bags of non-recyclable waste
eligibility_criteria.details: Threshold stated as more than 3 black bags
eligibility_criteria.exemptions: No exemption from this threshold stated

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Applicant recycles all accepted kerbside materials
eligibility_criteria.details: Application is for households that recycle all accepted kerbside materials and still produce excess non-recyclable waste

eligibility_criteria.criterion: No recyclable material is present in any black bags or exemption bags
eligibility_criteria.details: There is to be no recyclable material in any black or exemption bags for an exemption to be granted

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Waste type must fall within the available exemption categories
eligibility_criteria.details: Exemptions are available for waste such as pet litter or bedding and disposable nappies; form options are Nappies, Pet litter, Pet bedding

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Application must relate to a Swansea household address
eligibility_criteria.details: Form is operated by Swansea Council and requires address and postcode lookup/entry

evidence_requirements.verification_method: Checked against application form submission and/or postcode lookup

evidence_requirements.notes: Form asks 'What item would you like an exemption for?' with options: Nappies, Pet litter, Pet bedding

evidence_requirements.notes: Listed on form immediately before Submit

workflow_stages.description: Resident accesses the online exemption form and may choose Welsh or English language.
decision_points: Applicant chooses preferred language: Cymraeg or English
Applicant decides whether to proceed with online submission
caseworker_actions: No caseworker action at this stage in the scraped content

workflow_stages.description: Applicant enters personal and address details, including postcode lookup or manual address entry, and contact details.
decision_points: Address found via postcode lookup or entered manually
Mandatory fields completed or not completed
caseworker_actions: Later review completeness of submitted identity and contact details

workflow_stages.description: Applicant selects the waste item for which exemption is sought and may provide additional information.
decision_points: Selected item is Nappies, Pet litter, or Pet bedding
caseworker_actions: Review any additional information up to 1500 characters

workflow_stages.description: Applicant completes reCAPTCHA and submits the form.
caseworker_actions: Receive submitted application in council system

workflow_stages.description: Council assesses whether the household meets the exemption conditions, including recycling behaviour and absence of recyclable material in black or exemption bags.
decision_points: Whether applicant appears to recycle all accepted kerbside materials
Whether excess waste is over 3 black bags
Whether waste type falls within stated exemption categories
Whether there is any recyclable material in black or exemption bags
Whether terms and conditions are met
caseworker_actions: Determine whether exemption should be granted
Record that waste may be monitored if exemption is granted

workflow_stages.description: If granted, exemption is issued for an initial period and household waste may be monitored.
decision_points: Whether exemption remains appropriate during validity period
next_stages: Potential renewal or reapplication not described
Potential enforcement or withdrawal not described
caseworker_actions: Record validity period of 1 year initially

possible_outcomes: Granted - exemption to place out additional black bags
Refused - recyclable material present in black or exemption bags
Refused - applicant does not recycle all accepted kerbside materials
Refused - waste does not fall within stated exemption categories
Refused - applicant does not produce more than 3 black bags of non-recyclable waste

communication_touchpoints.content_summary: Language selection prompt offering Cymraeg and English

communication_touchpoints.trigger: Applicant reads service information before applying
communication_touchpoints.content_summary: Explains eligibility basis, no recyclable material rule, 1 year initial validity, possible monitoring, terms and conditions, and privacy information
